script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The quotation uses “I” without identifying God as the speaker first.
The joke presents the cloak as part of the offer, but the brother already has the cloak.
The text says the man seizes his brother, not that he grabs him by the cloak.
“Stone had nothing to do with it” rules out a connection the text does not address.
The dropped-cookie joke makes light of the serious sin being discussed. Its comparison also centers on hiding, while the passage says they do not conceal their sin.
“Nobody's packing a bag” claims that no one is preparing to leave, which the passage does not say.
The recipe joke trivializes the serious matter of God's people being misled, even with the qualification that it was less serious.
The claim that the temple is the most valuable place around is not stated in the passage.
